in_marathi.name: Namit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Name of a God

vedic_reference.note: Namit is a name mentioned in the Rigveda, the oldest known scripture in the Hindu tradition. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nāma’ meaning name, and the suffix ‘it’ indicating one who has or gives. This name is often used to denote a deity or a person with the power to bestow names.
